<parameter name="thinking">Tom and Leo are on the top and bottom lines, and the start is laid and connected. I have 12 in my tray and free hands, but tracing either stroke would collide with them. The tail is the risky part, so I'll offer to take it once their lines get there.</parameter>
<parameter name="say">Looking good, you two. Start's connected. I've got a full tray, so I'll take the tail once your lines get out there. Tom, Leo, shout if you want me to pick up the last stretch of either line so it goes faster.</parameter>
<parameter name="to">everyone</parameter>
<parameter name="eagerness">4</parameter>
<parameter name="do">stop</parameter>
<parameter name="notes">Fish sketch on pad (Priya). Tom is on stroke 1 (top, start laid), Leo on stroke 2 (bottom). I have 12 in tray, hands free. Plan: take over the tail end when lines reach it, using extend/connect, and inspect the tail corners (sharp, may not pass the fall). Offered to take the last stretch of either line if they want help.</parameter>
